decision: Accept this routing-only tradeoff with explicit qualification limits.
basis: Required 0.127 mm clearance is restored with 0.146285 mm minimum new-copper margin. All inherited widths, layers, complete ports and thermal/main-plane topology are retained. VSYS retains continuous In4 full-width projection. Small 5V In2 projection loss is measured, with no demonstrated device requirement violation.
limits: Power/transient/thermal qualification remains open; native DRC and geometry are not electrical certification.
